summary: Adapter enforces hidden_state=false, forbids shell commands, requires declared slice plus nonempty contract/validator hashes; execution requires strict Skill input gate and matching receipt/contract context hashes; lifecycle is prepared -> red-observed -> green-observed -> refactor-verified, with RED failing test and test/docs-only paths, GREEN passing production paths, REFACTOR passing within production/tests/docs; invalid transitions block with RMAP diagnostics; candidate is non-authoritative and authorizes nothing; resume rejects stale identity or failed/stale/superseded runs; stage bindings require capsule-attempt bundle v1, exactly one context/attempt per stage, matching plan/slice/run/attempt IDs, STAGE-{RED|GREEN|REFACTOR}, empty authorizations; protocol persistence validates artifact store, path containment, reparse-point absence, immutable conflicts, required ordered documents and preserves listed observations; execute rejects existing run dirs, requires bundle/store pairing, writes recovery-state.v1 with hashes, lineage null, stages, no authorizations; ambiguities: caller supplies events, protocol documents, artifact bytes, and authoritative acceptance/handoff/release remain outside adapter
